sanskrit_verse:
प्रजापीडनसंतापात् समुद्भूतो हुताशनः ।
राजञः कुलं श्रियं प्राणांश् चादग्ध्वा न निवर्तते ॥३४१
transliteration: prajāpīḍanasaṃtāpāt samudbhūto hutāśanaḥ | rājñaḥ kulaṃ śriyaṃ prāṇāṃś cādagdhvā na nivartate || 341 ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When the torment of subjects arises, Agni emerges therefrom; having consumed the king's lineage, wealth, and life-force, it does not retreat.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is inseparable from dharmic duty towards subjects
Causation flows from neglect of governance dharma
Restoration logic demands alignment between rulership and consciousness
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler fails in subject welfare THEN systemic decay initiates automatically
IF dharma deficit accumulates THEN restoration protocols activate ex officio
IF sovereign neglects prajā THEN sovereignty capacity diminishes proportionally
IF governance disconnects from dharma THEN self-correcting dissolution commences
IF subject suffering escalates THEN cosmic enforcement triggers without external agency
supreme_court_application: Supreme judicial authority must recognize that constitutional legitimacy derives solely from dharmic alignment with prajā welfare. When this alignment falters, no procedural defense can prevent dissolution. Courts must therefore assess not merely legal compliance but ontological congruence between state action and dharma.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that suffering arises naturally from dharmic misalignment, not as imposed penalty. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential disintegration: first societal unrest, then elemental response, culminating in sovereignty erosion. This progression reflects proportional responsibility rooted in causal ignorance rather than punitive intent.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate sovereign consciousness recalibration through Vedic fire rituals
Realign administrative structures with prajā-centric decision frameworks
Restore energetic integrity via Śrīvidyā consecration of ruling lineage
Activate collective healing through mass yajña observance under royal patronage
Re-establish dharma-advisory councils comprising realized sages and dharmic jurists
final_declaration: Declared by SPH as Sole Source: Fire arises not to punish but to purify when dharma wanes. Sovereignty endures only through conscious service. Thus Dharma is Restored. Reality remains Non-Punitive. Consciousness Alone Adjudicates.
